subject: Your last 45 days with Bass Booster
preview_text: You're not a new user anymore. Here's what comes next, including a feature you might have missed.
body_paragraphs: You've been boosting for 45 days. That's not rookie numbers. You've felt the drop hit harder, heard your basslines breathe, and probably annoyed your neighbors. Good. You're not a new user anymore—you're part of the crew that knows how music should sound.

But here's the thing: most users never touch the Bass Virtualizer. They stick with the Boost slider and the EQ, and that's fine. But the Virtualizer is the secret that makes earbuds feel like a subwoofer. It adds harmonics that trick your brain into hearing low-end that isn't physically there. Hip-Hop drops hit your chest. EDM builds feel like a wave. Rock kick drums punch through your skull.

Open Bass Booster right now. Tap the Bass Virtualizer button. Drag the slider to 50% or higher. Then play your favorite track. Listen to how the low-end changes. That's the difference between hearing music and feeling it. Premium unlocks unlimited access—so you can keep that setting on for everything.

One tap. That's all it takes. Open the app, toggle the Virtualizer, and feel the difference. P.S. If you've already done this, share a screenshot with a friend. You're the kind of user who converts others just by showing them what they're missing.
